description: This PHP class extends tlFilterPanel to manage filters and settings for test case filtering in the TestLink project. It includes logic for session management, filter configuration, tree building for test cases, and handles various modes such as edit, execution, plan, and plan add modes. It also manages user input initialization, filter application, and session persistence to facilitate GUI-level filtering and tree rendering in the TestLink test management system.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterControl
classes.description: A class that manages filtering and display of test cases within TestLink, providing mechanisms for user-input processing, session persistence, and dynamic test case tree generation across different modes such as editing, execution, and planning.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Builds the test case tree menu for display, filtering test cases based on current settings and modes, and prepares data for the GUI including AJAX loader setup.

methods.name: get_argument_string
methods.description: Generates a URL-encoded query string of active filters and settings for navigation or AJAX use.

methods.name: save_session_data
methods.description: Stores current filter and setting states into session variables, keyed by mode and form token, to persist user preferences across page loads.

methods.name: delete_old_session_data
methods.description: Removes outdated session entries based on a timestamp threshold for cleaner session data management.

methods.name: delete_own_session_data
methods.description: Deletes session data related to the current form token to reset filters for new operations.

methods.name: generate_form_token
methods.description: Creates a unique identifier (token) for the current filter session, to distinguish multiple tabs or sessions.

methods.name: set_testcases_to_show
methods.description: Sets which test cases should be displayed in the tree, updating session as needed.

methods.name: init_filter_result
methods.description: Initializes the filter settings for test results, including configuration loading, default value handling, and filter menu creation.

methods.name: init_filter_bugs
methods.description: Initializes the bug-related filters based on user input or resets.

methods.name: init_filter_workflow_status
methods.description: Initializes the workflow status filter with support for multiple selection and special domain loading.

methods.name: initTreeOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the test case tree display.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields for the test cases based on application area, with special processing for domain list types.

methods.name: init_advanced_filter_mode
methods.description: Sets the advanced filter mode based on the current mode.

methods.name: init_setting_testsgroupby
methods.description: Initializes the setting for test group by mode, loading localized labels.

methods.name: init_setting_exec_tree_counters_logic
methods.description: Initializes configuration for execution tree counters, including session management and domain validation.

methods.name: setFiltersDefinition
methods.description: Defines the set of input parameters, including validation rules, for all filters used in the control.

methods.name: init_filter_platforms
methods.description: Initializes platform filters, including data retrieval from platform manager and setting of active filters.
